title: Axiom Anchor art expansion
status: Concept art and authoring palette; no gameplay or engine implementation claimed
lore_scope: All object designs and manufacturing attributions are proposed visual interpretations. Existing lore motifs are preserved; no new world fact is established.
production_constraints: Use shared material ramps and connected clusters
Preserve readable function and silhouette before fine detail
Power, signal, fluid and card interfaces differ in shape
Show heat paths, service access and real support
Emission is sparse and tied to actual state after implementation
Do not reveal the ninth office, Surveyors or sender of the return
